globalDescription.english:
The First Sino-Japanese War began with the surprise attack by the Japanese Flying Squadron on the escorting group, Chi Yuan and Kuang Yi, as well as nearby transport ships. Ultimately, except for the Chi Yuan, which successfully disengaged from the battle, all other Chinese vessels were annihilated.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Pungdo
globalDescription.japanese:
日清戦争は、日本軍第一遊撃隊による「済遠」「広乙」からなる護衛隊と付近の輸送船への奇襲攻撃をもって始まりました。最終的に「済遠」が戦闘から離脱することに成功したほかは、他の清国艦船はすべて殲滅されました。
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Pungdo
globalDescription.chineseSimplified:
甲午战争以第一游击队突袭护航队（济远，广乙）与附近的运输船为开始。最终除济远成功脱离战斗，其他清军船只均被歼灭。
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Pungdo
globalDescription.chineseTraditional:
甲午戰爭以第一遊擊隊突襲護送「濟遠」、「廣乙」的船隊及附近運輸船為開端。最終除「濟遠」成功脫離戰鬥外，其餘清軍船隻均被殲滅。
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Pungdo
